title: Maintenance mode
description: Close the site to visitors and show a page instead. The site answers 503, which tells search engines the outage is temporary and leaves its indexing alone.

state.openEnded: Stays on until you turn it off

duration.label: How long
duration.hint: The site reopens by itself at the end of the window.

page.title: The page visitors see
page.heading: Heading
page.messagePlaceholder: This website is temporarily unavailable while we carry out maintenance.
page.logoHint: https only. The page is served over TLS, so an http image is blocked.
page.previewMessage: This website is temporarily unavailable while we carry out maintenance.

ips.title: Addresses that still reach the site
ips.hint: An address on this list sees the real site instead of the maintenance page. Exact addresses only, not ranges.
ips.empty: No address is excepted, so everyone sees the maintenance page.

confirmOff.title: Turn maintenance mode off?
confirmOff.message: The site becomes visible to everyone again straight away.

saveFailed: The maintenance settings could not be saved.
ipAddFailed: The address could not be added.
ipRemoveFailed: The address could not be removed.

notes.subdomains: Subdomains are not covered. Each one serves its own configuration and keeps working.
notes.wordpress: This is the site-wide switch and it takes effect before WordPress runs, so it overrides the WordPress maintenance tool.
notes.seo: Visitors and search engines get 503, which means temporarily unavailable. Your search ranking is not affected by a short outage.

reasons.unavailable: Maintenance mode is not available for this domain.
reasons.maintenance_custom_vhost: This domain serves a custom nginx configuration, which the panel does not modify. Remove it to use maintenance mode.
reasons.maintenance_redirect_only: This domain only redirects somewhere else, so it has no site to put into maintenance.
reasons.maintenance_bad_address: That is not a valid IP address.
reasons.maintenance_too_many_ips: The exception list is full. Remove an address before adding another.
